_comment: Milestone B trigger registry (bd: shode-roadmap/C-B1, ROADMAP-runtime-10.md SS 3.2; phase vocabulary reconciled bd: shode-roadmap/C-A6 iter0). Every route below is a verbatim transcription of a trigger rule that already exists in prose somewhere in this repo -- no new routing rule invented. See each entry's own `_source` for the exact file. Read by scripts/route.sh only -- NOT preloaded into any agent context. `phases` uses the SAME node ids as references/state-machine/transitions.json's `.states` (e.g. '1a-spec', '3b-review') -- state machine is the single source of truth for phase vocabulary (CLAUDE.md 'Repo'). C-B1 originally used a second, different vocabulary (phase_0/phase_1b/phase_3b/...) borrowed from ROADMAP-runtime-10.md SS3.3's own illustrative example; that was drift (two names for one concept) and is fixed here -- tests/test-registry.sh now asserts every id used here exists in transitions.json's states[] so it cannot silently drift again.
